query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.list
query.sql:
select ps.id, h.name as school, y.yearid, y.name as year, ps.name, ps.priority_open, ps.priority_close, ps.general_open, ps.general_close, ps.grade_levels, listagg(r.abbreviation,',') within group (order by r.id) as terms, ps.status
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join schools h on ps.schoolid = h.school_number inner join terms y on ps.yearid = y.yearid and y.isyearrec = 1 and y.schoolid = ps.schoolid inner join terms r on ps.termdcids like '%,'||r.dcid||',%'
where (:schoolid = '0' or ps.schoolid = :schoolid)
group by h.name, y.yearid, y.name, ps.name, ps.priority_open, ps.priority_close, ps.general_open, ps.general_close, ps.grade_levels, ps.id, ps.status
order by h.name, y.yearid desc, ps.name

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single
query.sql:
select id, schoolid, yearid, name, remarks, instructions, priority_open, priority_close, priority_limit, general_open, general_close, general_limit, grade_levels, termdcids, checkteacherschedule, blockapproval, studentsignup, siblingtimeslots, status
from u_ptc5_sessions
where id = :sessionid

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.courses
query.sql:
select distinct c.dcid, c.course_name, c.course_number
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join school_course hc on ps.schoolid = hc.schoolid and ps.yearid = hc.yearid inner join courses c on hc.courseid = c.id
where nvl(hc.status,0) = 1 and ps.id = :sessionid
order by c.course_name, c.course_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.sections
query.sql:
select distinct e.dcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst, c.dcid as coursedcid
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join terms r on ps.schoolid = r.schoolid and ps.yearid = r.yearid inner join sections e on r.id = e.termid and e.schoolid = ps.schoolid inner join courses c on c.course_number = e.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id
where ps.id = :sessionid and ps.termdcids like ',%'||r.dcid||',%'
order by section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.sections.override
query.sql:
select e.dcid, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst, listagg(d.id, ',') within group (order by d.id) as ccids
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join terms r on ps.schoolid = r.schoolid and ps.yearid = r.yearid inner join sections e on r.id = e.termid and e.schoolid = ps.schoolid inner join courses c on c.course_number = e.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id inner join cc d on e.id = d.sectionid
where ps.id = :sessionid and ps.termdcids like ',%'||r.dcid||',%'
group by e.dcid, c.course_name, e.course_number, e.section_number, t.lastfirst
order by section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.users
query.sql:
select distinct t.dcid, t.lastfirst
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join teachers t on ps.schoolid = t.schoolid
where ps.id = :sessionid and t.staffstatus in (1,4)
order by t.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.students
query.sql:
select distinct s.dcid, s.lastfirst
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join students s on ps.schoolid = s.schoolid
where ps.id = :sessionid and s.enroll_status in (0,-1) and ps.grade_levels like '%,'||s.grade_level||',%'
order by s.lastfirst

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.student.cc
query.sql:
select distinct d.id, c.course_name, e.course_number||'.'||e.section_number as section_number, t.lastfirst, e.dcid as sectiondcid, t.dcid as schoolstaffdcid, case when pmme.id is not null then 'e' when pmm.id is not null then 't' else '' end as mustmeet
from students s inner join cc d on s.id = d.studentid inner join sections e on d.sectionid = e.id inner join terms r on e.termid = r.id and e.schoolid = r.schoolid inner join courses c on e.course_number = c.course_number inner join teachers t on e.teacher = t.id left outer join u_ptc_mustmeetsections pmme on e.dcid = pmme.sectiondcid and pmme.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid left outer join u_ptc_mustmeet pmm on d.id = pmm.ccid and pmm.u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid
where s.dcid = :studentdcid and e.schoolid = (select schoolid from u_ptc5_sessions where id = :sessionid) and r.yearid = (select yearid from u_ptc5_sessions where id = :sessionid) and d.id not in (select ccid from u_ptc5_cc where u_ptc5_sessionsid = :sessionid and ccid is not null)
order by section_number

query.name: com.psugasia.ptc5.sessions.single.timeslots.count
query.sql:
select count(pt.id) as cnt
from u_ptc5_sessions ps inner join u_ptc5_timeslots pt on ps.id = pt.u_ptc5_sessionsid
where ps.id = :sessionid
